refinement_actions: Raised light-theme --primary/--ring/--gradient-start from #3b82f6 (3.5:1 as text) to #2563eb (>=4.7:1) and synced docs/DESIGN.canvas.tsx — axe color-contrast violations eliminated
Raised dark-theme --muted-foreground from #71717a to #a1a1aa to pass AA on the dark background
Added AA-safe gradient stops (#1d4ed8 -> #2563eb) for primary CTA surfaces so white button text passes in both themes
Fixed React #418 hydration error on /contributions by generating the randomized sample calendar only after mount (useSyncExternalStore gate)
Blog renderer now emits real <ul>/<ol> list semantics instead of flat paragraphs
Added sr-only <h1> to 15 pages that lacked a top-level heading; decorative GitHub icons marked aria-hidden
Labeled mock GitHub streak/contribution data as sample data per the no-fabricated-metrics constraint
Blog meta row made wrappable (flex-wrap) to prevent tag overflow on narrow viewports
